lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention, all personnel. Lab B is under routine quarantine. Please keep clear of the east corridor.

lines.speaker: crew_mess
lines.text: Morning, officer. Coffee's terrible again.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Legs! Take its legs!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Movement, left side!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Cover me, I'll get this open!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Agh! It got me!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I'll get the panel, go.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That door's sealed. Maybe there's another way round?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Clear. Everyone breathing?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Quiet. Something's in the water.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I didn't want you to see this.

lines.speaker: crew_lab
lines.text: [screaming]

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Supply sub Halcyon has docked at ring two. Day shift, please badge in. Night shift, thank you for your service.

lines.speaker: crew_ruiz
lines.text: Morning, Jay. Another thrilling night on the door?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Riveting. How'd your boy's recital go?

lines.speaker: crew_ruiz
lines.text: He forgot half of it and bowed twice. Best thing I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Morning, officer.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Welcome back, Sung. How's topside?

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Ten days of rain. I actually missed this place.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Morning, Jay. Still on that door since four?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Since three. Someone had to cover.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Look at that posture. He's part of the wall by now.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Morning, Giles. You look well rested.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Four hours and a bunk that hates me. Don't start.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: He's not starting. It's an observation.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Oh good, there's two of you now.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Kitchen. Before he gets worse.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Morning, Ruiz. Arms out for me.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: You're good. Have a good one.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Go ahead, Sung.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Morning, Doctor.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Every single morning, Giles.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It's a multitool. It's basically a limb at this point.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I'll put it in his chart. Patient is part pliers.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Go on. Get him a coffee.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Very funny, Jay.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: That's your sidearm, Jay. It beeps every time.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Still metal. Still beeping.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Jay, with us? Bram's promised real eggs.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: They're powdered, Giles. You ask every single morning.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: And every single morning I hope.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Anyway. The pump in ring three's making that noise again.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Arm bothering you?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Slept on it wrong. Walk it off.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Tell me if it keeps bothering you.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It's a sore arm, Tomas, not a surgical case.

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: Morning, all. Coffee's terrible again, before anyone asks.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Terrible is generous. I'll take two.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: One. Caffeine isn't a food group.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Morning, Bram. Kettle still holding up?

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: Since Giles fixed it. Only thing down here that works.

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: One each, then. Doctor's orders.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Traitor. Thanks, Bram.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Cheers, Bram. You're a saint.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It was one washer. I keep telling everyone.

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: Then fix the eggs next, genius.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Don't encourage him.

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: There you are. Tomas, go and sit. I've got the bay.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Your shift doesn't start until eight.

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: And yours started at six. Sit. That's medical advice.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: That's my line.

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: I know. I've been practising.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: She's better at it than you are.

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: That's your second cup, Giles. I'm counting.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Third. Don't tell him.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: How's Mara liking the new school?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Top of her class in maths. Gets that from her mother.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Expensive, though. Coffee?

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Morning, Jay. Doctor's orders: one cup.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Thanks, Priya. Save me a seat at lunch?

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Window seat. Don't be late.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Drink up. Briefing's in the gallery in ten.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Last quiet cup before the day starts.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Morning, all. Grab a wall, this'll be quick.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Hit the lock on that door behind you — keep the hall noise out.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Halcyon came in on time, for once. Divers, your sample run's cleared for oh-nine-hundred.

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Finally.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Doctor, med checks for everyone off the sub. Giles...

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Let me guess. Ring three pump.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Ring three pump.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: She loves me.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Jay, morning rounds. Hydroponics, the dive bay, and Admin has your new card.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Level 2? You're finally trusting me with the good doors?

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Don't make me regret it.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Good morning, Thalassa. A brief note before you start your day.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: As a precaution, Lab B is under a routine quarantine until further notice.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Please keep clear of the east corridor. There is no cause for concern.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Thank you. TAG Industries appreciates you.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: ...Nobody told me that.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Well. I feel reassured.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: All right. You heard the man. Go on, get to work.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Jay, come on. Heins hates waiting.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Coffee's not going anywhere. Gallery. Now.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist
lines.text: Morning, officer. Mind the misters, they've got opinions today.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Humidity alarm again, Wen?

lines.speaker: crew_botanist
lines.text: Third time this week. The tomatoes don't care. I do.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll sign you off. Try to keep them alive.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist
lines.text: Tell that to whoever keeps borrowing my shears.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist
lines.text: Storeroom's Level 2. Admin's very particular about the fertiliser.

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Jay! Case is by the launch trunk. Don't drop it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What's in it?

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Mud from the trench. Lab B ordered it. Lab B orders a lot of mud.

lines.speaker: crew_maint
lines.text: Lights are out down the back corridor again. Bring a torch.

lines.speaker: crew_sung
lines.text: Locker's signed. Thanks, officer.

lines.speaker: crew_assistant
lines.text: Officer. The Director is... busy. Your card's on his desk.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: No. No, tell them the samples stay sealed. I don't care who's asking.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Ah. Officer. Good morning. Your card, of course.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Everything all right, Director?

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Perfectly. A busy morning. TAG appreciates you.

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: Close the door on your way out.

lines.speaker: crew_assistant
lines.text: That feed's been doing that all week. Ignore it.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: All senior staff to the observation gallery. All senior staff to the observation gallery.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Jay, you hear that? Gallery. Something's up with Lab B.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Blinds up. Hale wants eyes on it. Nobody touches the glass.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Who's that in there? Is that Voss?

lines.speaker: crew_lab
lines.text: Help me. Please. It's under my skin.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: She's seizing. Open the door, I can help her!

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Door's locked from the other side!

lines.speaker: crew_lab
lines.text: [screaming]

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Jesus Christ!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: What the fuck?!

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Containment breach. Lockdown in effect. Please remain calm.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Glass is holding. Back away. Jay, get them out of here!

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Where did it go? It was right there. Where the hell did it go?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: That wasn't a seizure.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Is that one of the lab techs?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Not any more.

lines.speaker: radio_ops
lines.text: All sections, report. All sections, report status.

lines.speaker: radio_dock
lines.text: Ops, Docking Ring! Something's in the airlock, it's... it's coming thr—

lines.speaker: radio_launch
lines.text: It came up the launch trunk! Seal the Launch Hall, seal it, seal—

lines.speaker: radio_ops
lines.text: Say again, Launch Hall? Launch Hall, respond. Anyone on this chan—

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention. Main power has failed. Emergency lighting is now active. Thank you for your patience.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Twenty seconds. Maybe thirty. Keep it off me!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Open it! Open the door!
lines.direction: desperate, shouting at a door that will not open

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: Tomas. ...Tomas, it's out.
lines.direction: a terrified whisper, not daring to move

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Priya!

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [screaming]

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Biometric lock. Medical staff only. Give me five seconds.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: It knows me. Go.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Pressure's dead down here. There's a valve room somewhere, isn't there?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That's it. Hear that? She's breathing again.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Mara's nine. She does this thing where she asks what I fixed today.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I'm going to have a good one for her.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: You will.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Jay, behind you, the door! Something's coming up the stairs!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It's on the stairs! Don't let go of that wheel! Don't you let go!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Seal it! Seal it now!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It stopped. It just... stopped. Is it gone?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Its arms. God, Jay, its arms are still moving.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Control room. Thirty seconds to get power back. Hold the doors!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Two entrances. Watch both.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Halfway! Keep going!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Power! Doors sealing. We did it.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Everyone breathing?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Barely. Remind me to ask for a raise.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll write you a reference.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Lights in three, two...

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Three days. The coolant line through Lab B. I cut it on a panel.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Mara's school. If I reported it, I'd lose all of it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I was going to say. After the shift.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...Giles.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: August-

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Stay back, Tomas.

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: [screaming]
